name: RCM_COLLIDE
meaning: Move runs Collide_ResolveMove (set by Init and 0x1F/0x20; never cleared)

name: RCM_CLAMP_ENDS
meaning: stop at the trajectory ends instead of wrapping

name: RCM_DRIVEN
meaning: driven by a RollingCarpet/SensibleButton message; one-frame latch

name: RCM_SNAPPED
meaning: a waypoint was consumed this step; Move snaps onto snapPoint

name: RCM_IN_RADIUS
meaning: scratch: current waypoint within the arrive radius
